description: This file defines the EscaperRuntime class in Twig, implementing security and encoding strategies for escaping output to prevent injection vulnerabilities. It includes methods for setting, retrieving, and applying different escaping strategies such as HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and URL encoding.

classes.name: EscaperRuntime
classes.description: Final class implementing escaping mechanisms for Twig, managing various strategies and safe classes for output encoding.

methods.name: setEscaper
methods.description: Defines a new escaping strategy with a callable implementation.

methods.name: getEscapers
methods.description: Retrieves all currently defined escaping strategies.

methods.name: setSafeClasses
methods.description: Sets multiple safe classes with associated escaping strategies.

methods.name: addSafeClass
methods.description: Adds a safe class with specified strategies to the safe classes list.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Performs escaping on a string using the specified strategy, respecting autoescape and safe classes.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts string encoding between specified character sets.
